## 🔀 WHAT WAS MERGED WHERE

### PRIME_SOP v2.8 (12 stages, 32 D-rules) → Universal SOP v1.3 (6 stages, 16 SubSOPs)

| 🆔 Old (PRIME_SOP) | 🆔 New (Universal SOP v1.3) |
|--------------------|------------------------------|
| Stage 1 Understand | Stage 1 — same |
| Stage 1.5 Backup | Folded into Stage 1B + SP.4 SCP (System Change Protocol) |
| Stage 2 Align + Stage 5 Verify sources | SP.6 IAC (Intent Alignment Check) + SP.5 FSP (Fidelity Substantiation Protocol) |
| Stage 3 Measure | Stage 2 (now) + SP.3 TTE (Token Threshold Engine) |
| Stage 4 Plan | Folded into Stage 2 Measure |
| Stage 6 Draft + Stage 6.5 Mid-QA | Stage 3 Execute + EN.1 Output Skeleton |
| Stage 7 Self-check + Stage 7.5 Error scan | Stage 4 Self-Check + SP.10 SCC + EN.4 Pulse Check |
| Stage 8-9 Validate + Verify (agents) | Same (Validator-Merged + Karen) |
| Stage 10 Document | Cache architecture + CONTINUATION.md |
| Stage 11 Communicate | Stage 5 Wrap-Up (Conclusion + Timeline + Foresight + SHR + Debt + SubSOP Report) |
| Stage 12 Confirm | Stage 6 Confirm |
| D1 (one step at a time) | Tier system (QUICK/STANDARD/COMPLEX) + SP.16 PCG (Prompt Completion Gate) |
| D2 (confirm before proceed) | Stage 6 + 💠 confirmation markers |
| D6 (never assume) | SP.6 IAC + Understanding Check |
| D7 (5th grader simplicity) | Validator-Merged Section C |
| D17 (Sarah Turner 5-part check) | APW-specific — not in Universal SOP |
| D19 POVP | SP.10 SCC (Self-Compliance Check) + EN.4 Pulse Check |
| D20 (real-time checklist) | Step tracking table (mandatory) |
| D21 PFV (Process Flow Verification) | SP.15 EEP (Execution Enforcement Protocol) + SP.16 PCG |
| D25 (session start) | SESSION_START.md + Controller session-start protocol |
| D27 (token transparency) | SP.3 TTE (Token Threshold Engine) + LTM (Live Token Monitor) |
| D28 (cache update after decisions) | Controller's C.14-C.16 + SESSION_STATE.md decisions log |
| D29 (step header) | Universal SOP step header format (STEP / SOP / TIER / EST) |
| D32 (backup before modify) | SP.4 SCP (System Change Protocol) + BACKUP_LOG.md |

### BRIDGE_SOP v1.1 → Visual + Operations Protocols

| 🆔 Old (BRIDGE_SOP) | 🆔 New (Universal SOP v1.3) |
|---------------------|------------------------------|
| Debrief Block + Process Position | Step header + Step tracking table |
| Icon Guide (✅❌🔄❗⚠️⛔🌱💠🎯📍) | Icon usage in Universal SOP Stage 1 + standardized across all SubSOPs |
| Visual protocol (emojis far left, tables) | SP.1 MagNet (Magnetic Visual Engagement Protocol) |
| 100% accuracy floor | SP.5 FSP (Fidelity Substantiation Protocol) + EN.4 Pulse Check |
| Promise = deliver in same message | SP.15 EEP (Execution Enforcement Protocol) |

### SOP_FULL_REFERENCE.md → 16 SubSOPs

The 119+ prompt items were clustered into 16 functional SubSOPs (SP.1-SP.16) plus 4 Ensurance components (EN.1-EN.4). See PROTOCOLS_REFERENCE.md for the full mapping.
